Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent game papercraft sprite atlas, landscape 1536x1024.
Create twelve physically separate individually cut paper props for Pokémon Emerald Rustboro City, a rich detailed miniature stage. Not volumetric toy buildings, not low-poly chunks. Warm cream limestone, terracotta tile roofs, teal windows, leafy greens. Lighting soft from top left, no background or cast shadows outside the silhouettes.
Arrange exactly a 4-column by 3-row atlas. Each cell approx 384x341, 20px transparent gap; every silhouette entirely separate with genuine alpha, no touching. Row 1 left to right: (1) tall cream Devon corporation tower facade with blue vertical glass inserts, rooftop ornaments, detailed cut-paper windows, no text; (2) residential cream townhouse facade with red roof, little window shutters, balcony and little chimney on left; (3) Rustboro stone Pokémon gym facade, stepped stone entry, circular abstract emblem no lettering; (4) narrow steep distant ridge with green trees and layered grey rocks. Row 2: (1) broad asymmetrical low garden wall with flowering shrub and built-in bench; (2) one full tree made of many small overlapping cut-paper leaves, visible trunk; (3) round low stone trainer podium, broad flat pale top, very short sides in front 3/4 perspective; (4) richly layered hedge and daisies, full silhouette. Row 3: (1) three-lobed paper cloud with overlapping small lobes; (2) separate small curved cream smoke puff as one paper silhouette; (3) little old-fashioned bronze street lantern on a slim pole with cut-paper yellow light insert; (4) narrow pair of decorative terracotta pennants attached to one short cream horizontal paper bar. No labels, cell dividers, checkerboard, ball, complete scene, people or Pokémon. Every prop complete, never cropped. Transparent background.
